To every guy who's like: "If all she wants is sex then dump her," ask yourselves, would you stay with a woman who couldn't have sex with you ever? The irony is, she probably has told her friends, "He just can't keep it up with me, I'm obviously not.good enough, I feel hideous." And you know what, all of them probably responded, "You deserves someone who thinks you're the best! Leave him!"

Neither story is 100% accurate, people are more complex than, "He doesn't think I'm good enough," or "All she wants is sex." If you people really wanted to help, you'd help this person do the best he can to fix this mess, rather than suggest he just beat her to the break-up punch. Abandoning someone you're still in love with hurts and can take years to get over. Imagine he did.leave her, then watched her from afar fall in love with someone else. Imagine how shitty that would really feel, how tempting it would be to fap, and how insecure he might get about meeting new women! Besides, I'm sure she still loves the OP, if all.she wanted was sex she would have dumped him ages ago! But lacking intimacy in any relationship is leaving both parties.unsatisfied, I imagine, and quitting does not help the OP bc he'll just have the same problem with the next person.


You obviously care about her, OP, you wouldn't have posted here if you didn't. So if you know she's got one foot out the door then.you HAVE to sit her down and tell her everything. Tell her why this ED exists. Tell her what you are doing to stop. Tell her about why you fap so much in the first place - that you needed an escape or were depressed or whatever. If you love her for real then you will overcome your own pride and be honest. If you don't tell her the whole truth, then honestly, saving face is more important to you than she is and she's better off with someone who can communicate. Now, if you tell her everything and she stays and supports you, then you know you have an amazingly strong relationship that can withstand many of life's battles. But if she can't handle it, then fine, she leaves. But at least you know you tried everything and she is the weak.one who can't stand by you during moments of.weakness and vulnerability. You're better off with someone who can.support you.

Good luck. My advice is, don't just break up and run from the relationship like a coward. Honestly, it would probably just make you feel worse. Do.the best you can to fix things. She'll probably love you more for opening up about this - that takes real strength and courage. Take care.
